objectRequest.name: Picker's Hollow - Teal Salvage Jacket - male
objectRequest.description: One standalone empty muted teal canvas salvage work jacket, front view in a cozy low-top-down pixel-art RPG. Closed central brass fastening, small fold-down collar, two symmetrical practical chest patch pockets, long sleeves with dark cuffs and modest reinforced dark-teal elbow patches, straight hip-length hem. Crisp one-pixel dark outline, simple clusters and restrained shading, no tiny decorative noise. Same design for both body types. Male cut: broad shoulders, straight roomy torso, square waist; relaxed long sleeves hang naturally beside the torso. Garment only, no body, skin, head, hands, pants, mannequin, hanger, text, logo, scenery or ground shadow. Transparent native 48x64 canvas.
